title: Filter cost reports by transcript project name
rubric: The CLI exposes repeatable --project and --exclude-project options that also split comma-separated patterns.
Filter normalization, including normalize_project_patterns, rejects empty patterns and path-like patterns with argparse exit status 2.
Project matching, including project_allowed, uses case-sensitive fnmatchcase semantics with exclude patterns overriding includes.
build_report_payload accepts project/exclude_project keywords and always emits the project_filters object.
Filtering is applied before parsing and deduplication, so excluded projects affect no totals, sessions, unknown models, candidates, errors, or dedupe state.
Filtered markdown includes the exact Project filters line, while unfiltered markdown remains byte-for-byte unchanged.
Empty filtered results preserve found:false, dir_present:true, zero totals, and the existing no-transcripts-in-window label.
New unit tests cover validation, glob/tie precedence, JSON payload shape, and unchanged unfiltered behaviour without hardcoded prices or model ids.
